cohort: Healthy nulliparous women with a singleton, term cephalic pregnancy undergoing induction of labor.
finding: Cervical tissue elasticity (higher E/softer cervix) was significantly different between vaginal delivery and cesarean section groups, and maternal height was identified as a significant independent predictor of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The study found that cervical tissue elasticity was significantly higher (softer) in the vaginal delivery group, and maternal height was a significant independent predictor of cesarean delivery, highlighting their roles in predicting mode of birth after labor induction.
